# Board Game Audio Assistant

> Hands-free 9-language offline voice narrator, local Wi-Fi secret role dealer, offline rule lookup, party stats chronicle, and Bayesian probability solver for Avalon, Blood on the Clocktower, Classic Werewolf, Secret Hitler, and party board games on iPhone and iPad.

Board Game Audio Assistant is an offline iPhone and iPad app that acts as an automated voice narrator, local Wi-Fi secret role dealer, offline rulebook, and tabletop toolkit for social deduction and party board games — requiring zero internet connection or user account. Nobody sits out as a human moderator: everyone closes their eyes and plays together.

## Key features

- Studio-Grade 9-Language Voice Host (1,638 Audio Files): Crystal-clear offline night-phase scripts with Beginner, Standard, and Veteran pacing presets across English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish, and Portuguese for The Resistance: Avalon, Blood on the Clocktower (Trouble Brewing), multi-night Classic Werewolf, One Night Ultimate Werewolf & Daybreak, Secret Chancellor (Secret Hitler), The Resistance, Salem 1692, Blood and Blade, Dying Message, Cheese Thief, and Werewords.
- Multi-Game Local Wi-Fi Rooms (Zero Internet): Host a peer-to-peer room over local Wi-Fi or personal hotspot via 4-digit code or QR scan so players view secret roles and cast votes or night actions on their own phones in their preferred language.
- 100% Offline 9-Language Rule Lookup (174 Official Rulings): Instant edge-case rule rulings across 9 social deduction games with one-tap current-role chips in airplane mode.
- Avalon Bayesian Probability Solver, Party Stats & 3x Parchment Share Cards: Compute real-time role probabilities, review on-device Avalon post-game recaps, track faction win rates, and export vintage match chronicle cards.
- Custom Script Builder (.bgaa AirDrop Sharing), Siri Shortcuts & 4-in-1 Toolbox: Record personalized voice packs, share .bgaa scripts with friends for free, launch via Siri or Action Button, and access multi-sided dice, first-player picker, timers, scoreboards, and 17 BGG game guides.
- Optional Lifetime PRO: Zero banner ads app-wide; one-time In-App Purchase removes interstitial ads permanently with Family Sharing, room-wide host sponsorship, full party stats, and unlimited custom scripts.

## FAQ

### Does Board Game Audio Assistant work completely offline without internet or an account?

Yes. All 1,638 studio voice narration files, 174 offline rule lookup entries, 17 BGG board game references, party match history, dice rollers, countdown timers, and scoreboards run 100% offline on your iPhone or iPad with zero account registration. Even multi-phone secret role dealing and voting run peer-to-peer over local Wi-Fi or personal hotspot without internet.

### Which board games and languages include studio voice narration?

Built-in studio neural voice narration and tabletop modules cover The Resistance: Avalon, Blood on the Clocktower (Trouble Brewing), multi-night Classic Werewolf, One Night Ultimate Werewolf & Daybreak, Secret Chancellor (Secret Hitler), The Resistance, Salem 1692, Blood and Blade, Dying Message, Cheese Thief, and Werewords across 9 languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese.

### How does Local Wi-Fi secret role dealing and anonymous voting work?

One player taps Create Local Room on their iPhone or iPad while friends on the same Wi-Fi or personal hotspot join with a 4-digit room code or QR scan. Each player privately views their dealt 3D secret role card in their own language and casts encrypted votes or night actions in Avalon, Blood on the Clocktower, Classic Werewolf, and Secret Chancellor without passing phones.

### Does it include offline rule lookup and party match stats?

Yes. The 100% offline Rule Lookup includes 174 official edge-case rulings across 9 social deduction games in all 9 languages, with current-role quick chips for instant answers in airplane mode. The Party Stats Dashboard tracks faction win rates and exports 3x vintage parchment match chronicle share cards on-device.

### Is Board Game Audio Assistant free, or does it require a recurring subscription?

Core voice hosting, all 1,638 9-language voice files, local Wi-Fi rooms, 174 offline rule rulings, Avalon local recap, and the 4-in-1 tabletop toolbox are free with zero banner ads and zero subscriptions. An optional one-time Lifetime Ad-Free PRO purchase removes interstitial ads permanently with Apple Family Sharing, host room-wide ad-free sessions, unlimited custom scripts, and watermark-free match cards.

### Can I record custom voice packs or share custom night-phase scripts with friends?

Yes. The built-in Voice Recording Studio saves personalized friend or character voice lines locally on your device, and the Custom Script Builder exports compact .bgaa script packages via AirDrop or Share Sheet so friends can preview and import custom night-phase flows for free.
